- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds new units or functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 💄 UI / UX enhancement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI update
